## Severity: P2

## Context

During R2 (FIRST_PAYMENT / EntitlementProvider / ProtectedScreen) audit of mobile, claim #2 was confirmed but downgraded from P1→P2 because the misattributed scope (it was reported as a logic bug but the actual finding is a non-functional side-effect under StrictMode dev double-mount).

## Finding

`CheckoutReturnScreen` invokes `refreshEntitlement()` inside a `useEffect` with `[]` deps on mount. Under React 19 StrictMode (default in dev), the effect fires twice → two parallel `GET /entitlement` calls. Production runs are single-fire (no StrictMode), so this is dev-noise only. However:

- It pollutes Sentry breadcrumbs during dev sessions and obscures real entitlement-fetch failures.
- If the backend ever rate-limits the entitlement endpoint per-user-per-second (currently it does not), this would become a P1.
- The pattern is repeated in three other `ProtectedScreen`-adjacent components — fixing `CheckoutReturnScreen` sets a template.

## Fix sketch

Wrap with a `useRef`-backed run-once guard, or move the call to a route-focus listener (`useFocusEffect` from `react-navigation`) so re-entry is intentional rather than mount-coupled.

## Acceptance

Dev StrictMode no longer produces double `GET /entitlement` calls on `CheckoutReturnScreen` mount; pattern documented for the 3 sibling components.

## Source

R2 audit, Lens A verdict file (now stranded in wedged sandbox; reconstruct from `git blame` on `CheckoutReturnScreen` + `EntitlementProvider`). See also session audit report at `r2_claims_audit_report.md` (referenced in `HANDOFF_OP_50.md`).

## Origin

Filed as part of the Operator-49 → Operator-50 R81-backfill P2 batch (mobile track). See `handoffs/quality-bar-raise/current-state.json` `session_findings_to_file[R2-Claim-2]` for telemetry pointer.
title: [P2] CheckoutReturnScreen calls refreshEntitlement without StrictMode/double-mount guard — duplicate API hit on iOS dev
